Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment-art atlas for a side-view 2D stealth game. ExactlyFOUR separate landscape16:9panoramas arranged in a2columnsby2rowsgrid, with a thin straight purecyan dividing line centered both horizontally and vertically. Overallcanvas16:9; ideally3072x1728. Everypanel depicts a different EMPTY interior as a polished realistically hand-painted game matte painting. Side-scrolling camera facing broad backwall at eye-level, not isometric, no overhead. Lower25percent of EVERYpanel clear level uninterrupted foreground floor, dark/subdued enough for moving pixelcharacters, no holes/steps or central props. Architecture mainly above that floor. Preserve a grounded earlyMetalGear industrial military atmosphere. NO people, soldiers, faces, silhouettes of people, animals, vehicles, mechs, robots, actual MetalGear, weapons, text, labels, signs, logos, UI, borders apart from the cyan dividers. No ocean/outdoor view, no windows tosky. Create original faithful side-view adaptations, not copies of official screenshots.
FRANCHISE: MetalGear1987MSX, OuterHeaven SouthAfrica1995, ColdWar brutalist interiors, mutedolive/concrete/steel, practical incandescent and fluorescent lighting, no futuristic holograms.
TOPLEFT: OuterHeaven prison holdingblock, barred emptycells in broad rearwall, battered concrete, secured steel doors, walllamps and sparse bench behindbars.
TOPRIGHT: OuterHeaven industrial passage, long horizontal corridor with olivegreen paintedconcrete, rivetedmetal, exposed pipes and conduit, yellowblack cautiontrim restrained, no vanishingpointtunnel.
BOTTOMLEFT: TX55 underground maintenancehangar EMPTY, huge reinforced concrete chamber, gantrybeams overhead, industrial cableconduits and sidewall accesswalkways. Centralrearbay dark and VACANT; there is NO mech, no tank, no robot, no large silhouette.

mgs1-extra:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment-art atlas for a side-view2Dstealth game. Exactly FOUR separate landscape16:9panoramas arranged2columnsby2rows, with one thin purecyan verticaldivider and one purecyan horizontaldivider centered. Overall16:9canvas, ideally3072x1728. Each panel is a new original realistic hand-painted side-view adaptation of a MetalGearSolid1998 ShadowMoses2005 interior. Flat clear uninterrupted foregroundplayfloor in lower25percent of EVERYpanel, suitable for pixelcharacters added later. EnvironmentONLY. No people, mannequins, body statues, portraits of people, animals, ghosts, robots, vehicles, mechs, weapons, text, numbers, labels, UI, logos, watermarks. No outside snowfield, sky or ocean. Never copy an official screenshot; preserve recognizable materials/layout motifs, no claim of exact official reproduction.
TOPLEFT: ShadowMoses undergroundholdingcells, grayconcretebunker with empty steelbarredcells facing camera, simple emptybunks againstbackwall, fluorescentlamps, metalpipes. Cold bluegraycolorgrade, clear flatconcretefrontfloor.
TOPRIGHT: the commander's office/study where PsychoMantis is fought, restrained dark classicaloffice inside militaryfacility: darkwood bookshelves onrearwall, mutedgreen walls anddarkwood trim, a plainwooddesk againstbackwall, dark redbrown patternedrug onlyinmiddleground. Modest old officeroom, not cathedral or occulttemple. No statues, paintings of people, magic, floatingobjects, candles or invented symbols. Lowerforegroundcleardarkwoodorstonefloor; shelvesanddeskkeptbehind gameplayband.
BOTTOMLEFT: wolfdog cave interior atShadowMoses, rough naturalgrayrock walls, low jaggedrockceiling and shallowrecesses, dark cool rocky atmosphere, no frozenicecave, no buildings, no torchfantasy, no animals. Lateral horizontal cavepassage with levelpackedearth+stoneforefloor, allrocksconfinedtobackwall/upperedges socharacterscanmove clearly.
BOTTOMRIGHT: VulcanRaven refrigeratedstoragewarehouse, cold industrialroom, stacked largegraymetalstoragecontainers alongbackwall, insulatedmetalwallpanels and overheadrefrigerationpipes/vents, light frost oncontaineredges, mutedbluegraycold lighting, clear flatconcretefloor with subtlecoldhaze. No monster, no person, no robot, no palletjack. Containers behindgameplayband; NO cratesblockingforeground.
